, HIB LEASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY AND BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF MIDDLE TENNESSEE, INC. THIS LEASE AGREEMENT is made and entered into on this 17th day of September, 1996, between THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY, a Tennessee municipal corporation (hereinafter referred to as "LESSOR"), and BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF MIDDLE TENNESSEE, INC., a Tennessee nonprofit corporation, (hereinafter referred to as "LESSEE"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, LESSOR is a public corporation created pursuant to the laws of the State of Tennessee, and vested with the authority to lease real property pursuant to Section 1.01 of the Metropolitan Charter; and, WHEREAS, Section 2.24.210 of the Metropolitan Code of Laws provides that “[t]he director of public property administration shall be responsible for the leasing, operation and management of all public property where not otherwise provided by the Metropolitan Charter or by ordinance .”; and, WHEREAS, LESSOR owns certain surplus real estate containing approximately 36,800 square feet which is part of the property that was formerly used for Pearl Elementary School; and, WHEREAS, LESSEE is a nonprofit corporation that desires to lease said real property from LESSOR for the purpose of constructing and operating a Boys and Girls Club; NOW, THEREFORE, for valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which is hereby acknowledged and for the mutual promises hereinafter set out, and subject to the conditions, limitations and for the rent or royalty hereinafter established, LESSOR does hereby let and lease unto said LESSEE all parts and portions of the Leased Premises, for the purpose of building and operating a Boys & Girls Club, and only for lawful purposes attendant to such use.
SECTION

sections.heading: SECTION

blocks.text: 1. TERM. LESSEE is hereby granted the exclusive lease and use of the premises located at 916 Sixteenth Avenue North and further described in Section 2 of this Lease for a term of fifty years beginning on the first day of September, 1996 (hereinafter “Commencement Date”), and ending on the thirty-first day of August, 2046 (hereinafter “Ending Date”). LESSEE is further granted the option to renew this Lease for an additional term of fifty years. Exercise of the option to extend this Lease must be in writing, signed by all of the parties and their representatives who have signed hereto, and filed in the Office of the Metropolitan Clerk. Should LESSEE remain in possession of the Leased Premises beyond the Ending Date of the original or any extended term, LESSEE shall be a tenant from month to month, whereby either party can terminate this Lease upon thirty days written notice to the other party.

LESSOR reserves the right to cure any default without terminating this Lease and seek reimbursement for such expenses from LESSEE, with the understanding that LESSOR is under no obligation to correct any such default. It shall be grounds for Termination of this Lease upon the following: (i) Should LESSEE file a voluntary petition in bankruptcy or be adjudicated a bankrupt or insolvent, or shall file any petition or answer seeking any reorganization, arrangement, composition, readjustment, liquidation, dissolution of similar relief under any present or future bankruptcy or other applicable law, or shall seek or consent to or acquiesce in the appointment of any trustee, receiver or liquidator of LESSEE or of all or any substantial part of LESSEE's property or its leasehold interest in the Leased Premises, or shall make any genera! assignment for the benefit of creditors, or shall admit in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due, or (ti) (a) a court of competent jurisdiction shall enter an order, judgment or decree approving a petition filed against LESSEE seeking any reorganization, arrangement, composition, readjustment, liquidation, dissolution or similar relief under any present or future bankruptcy or other applicable law, or (b) any trustee, receiver or liquidator of LESSEE or of all or any substantial part of LESSEE's property or its leasehold interest in the Leased Premises shall be appointed without the consent or acquiescence of LESSEE; and such order, judgment, decree or appointment shall remain un-vacated or un-stayed for an aggregate of sixty (60) days (whether consecutive or nonconsecutive). Termination for Convenience In the event this Lease is terminated for default and it is later determined that LESSEE was not in default, then such termination shall be deemed a Termination for Convenience, as if the LESSOR had the right to terminate without cause upon written notice to the LESSEE, and for which no damages shall be imposed. d. Termination for Governmental Purpose. This Lease may be terminated should LESSOR or superior governmental authority decide to use the Leased Premises for a governmental purpose. Upon such event, LESSOR shall use best efforts to provide suitable alternative space subject to the same terms and conditions of this Lease.

Neither LESSOR nor LESSEE shall be deemed in violation of this Lease if it is prevented from performing any of the obligations hereunder by reason of strikes, boycotts, labor disputes, embargoes, shortage of material, act of God, acts of the public enemy, acts of superior governmental authority, weather conditions, riots, rebellion, sabotage, court order or any other circumstances for which it is not responsible or which is not within its control.
